claim: Publisher and founder of LIFugitiveFinder.com, a crime-fighting website
finding: His company published the Long Island Fugitive Finder magazine and website; the magazine closed after COVID but the website is still active.

claim: State Senator for the 3rd District, finishing his first four years
finding: He took office in the SD3 seat on January 1, 2023, after earlier Assembly service (2010–2012).

claim: Passed the "Suffolk County Water Restoration Act"
finding: The act (S8473/A8993) was sponsored by Sen. Monica Martinez and authored by Assemblyman Fred Thiele; it passed the Senate 57-1 and was signed May 23, 2024. He could have voted for it, but he did not pass it.

claim: Brought "Billions" in state aid for Long Island schools
finding: School aid flows through the statewide budget and formulas; no figure is given and no member brings it alone.

claim: Introduced legislation to address the opioid and fentanyl epidemic and fought congestion pricing
finding: Advocacy and bill introductions; no bill numbers given.

claim: New York "leads the nation" in residents leaving for other states
finding: On a percentage basis New York had the highest loss to domestic migration; in raw numbers it was second to California.

claim: "Since 2019" New York has been under one-party rule
finding: Democrats have held the Governor's office, the Assembly and, since 2019, the Senate.
